$comment: TAUT deployment TEMPLATE — rename this folder to your project's name and set `name` below to match (the compile enforces the equality). Structural keys (name/description/mode/repos) are consumed by setup; everything under `manifest` passes VERBATIM into the generated workspace manifest — including these $comment/note keys, which is deliberate: they document the values for the agents reading them. Guide: manual/GETTING-STARTED.md · full reference: the engine's docs/PACK.md.
name: starter
description: Starter deployment (rename me) — your project on the TAUT base flow

repos.$comment: Deliberately EMPTY: this pack is generic — setup scans your landscape root (two levels deep) and connects every repository it finds, then scaffolds a descriptor skeleton for each in the WORKSPACE (repos/<name>/descriptor.md). Add entries here only when you want to CURATE (a non-empty map connects only what it lists) or to declare a role/stack the file probes cannot guess: "my-app": { "role": "the web front end", "stack": ["jvm", "android"] }.

defaults.$comment: chat: "auto" = the session mirrors the language the developer writes in; replace with a fixed code ("en", "cs", …) or an {options, default} choice to add a setup question.

manifest.note: This bag ships verbatim into the workspace manifest. Grow it when a real driver appears — conventional blocks: flow.tracker (your ticket system's pattern and access mode), modelTiers (the model ladder — engine docs/PACK.md par.8), stacks (runbook-backed run recipes). Starting minimal is the feature, not the gap.
